hook: Waiting on every single shot and losing your mind.
beats: Birdie: You nap twice a day.
setting: On the fairway, both babies standing with arms crossed, open grass and a stalled group visible far ahead.
action: Mulligan taps his tiny foot impatiently and sighs at the group ahead, Birdie deadpans back at him.
judge: 'You nap twice a day' is a decent baby-jab but the last line fizzles.
